_note: Needs an operator installed cluster-wide — CloudNativePG here (v1.30.0 on the test cluster). Two RBAC realities shaped this lab: a tenant may NOT list cluster-scoped CRDs, so the API is read through discovery (oc api-resources / oc explain); and the Educates session role knows nothing about postgresql.cnpg.io, so session.objects grants the kind in the session's own namespace — the shape a real entitlement takes. The CR sets no imageName: the operator picks the operand image, which is the ownership point AND what lets the manifest run anywhere. Verified: a 1-instance Cluster reaches 'Cluster in healthy state' in about 40 seconds.
